1
Liquid iron is cooled to form solid iron.
Which statement about the particles in iron is correct?
A
The particles move further apart.
B
The particles move faster.
C
The position of the particles becomes fixed.
D
The attractions between the particles become weaker.

options.label: C
options.text: The position of the particles becomes fixed.

options.label: D
options.text: The attractions between the particles become weaker.
